ticker.label: Announcements
items: Business Registration is now processed through a single connected journey across three departments.
Citizens can withdraw data-sharing consent for any application at any time.
Department connector health is published on the Administration dashboard.
New: per-scope consent ledger and tamper-evident audit trail.

home.bannerTitle: One application. The right departments. A clear decision.
home.bannerText: Apply for a government service once. SetuGov routes it to every department that must act, and each verifies only the information you have consented to share.

noticesItems.text: Standard operating procedure for connector onboarding published.
Right to Public Services timelines mapped to workflow milestones.
Consent access log made visible to citizens on every application.
Audit trail verification report available for download by administrators.

home.step1: Apply once — Fill one guided form and choose exactly which information each department may use.
home.step2: Departments coordinate — Independent systems exchange only normalised, purpose-limited data through connector contracts.
home.step3: Track every step — Follow a single timeline across departments with remarks, timestamps and data-sharing history.
home.trustConsent: Consent is purpose-limited and per-scope, and can be withdrawn at any time.
home.trustAudit: Every action is written to a tamper-evident, hash-chained audit log.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
body: SetuGov is committed to ensuring that its services are accessible to all users, including persons with disabilities, in line with the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW) and WCAG 2.1 Level AA.
The site provides keyboard navigation, visible focus indicators, resizable text (A- / A / A+), light, dark and system themes, and semantic landmarks for assistive technologies.
If you experience any difficulty accessing content, please contact the helpline or file a grievance and we will assist you.

help.title: Help & Support
body: Choose a service from the Service Directory, review the departments and documents involved, and start a single application.
Track progress from the Track Application page. You can withdraw data-sharing consent at any time from the Consent & Data page.
For assistance, call the helpline shown in the header or raise a grievance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
body: SetuGov coordinates the exchange of information between government departments. Departments remain the authoritative holders of their own records.
SetuGov stores application details you provide, the consent scopes you grant, coordination metadata and a tamper-evident audit trail. It does not store copies of departmental source records.
Data is shared with a department only after you grant purpose-limited consent for a specific scope, and only for that purpose.

terms.title: Terms of Use
body: This portal is provided for availing connected government services. Information submitted must be accurate and lawful.
Misuse, including submission of false information, may lead to rejection of applications and further action under applicable law.

rti.title: Right to Information
body: Requests under the Right to Information Act, 2005 may be filed with the concerned Public Information Officer of the department administering the relevant service.
SetuGov's audit trail can be used to establish the timeline and status of an application.
